name: apple-books-mcp
description: Read your Apple Books library, highlights, notes and reading progress
long_description:
Lets Claude read the Apple Books library on this Mac: books, collections, highlights, notes, reading progress and chapter text.

The first time it reads the library, macOS asks whether Claude may access data from other apps. Click **Allow**.

It only reads the library unless you turn on **Allow editing collections**. Edits (creating, renaming and deleting collections, adding and removing books) refuse to run while Books is open, and every change takes a backup first.

enable_writes.title: Allow editing collections
enable_writes.description: Lets Claude create, rename and delete collections and add or remove books. Edits refuse to run while Books is open, and every change takes a backup first.
